driver.title: Tiger Woods' Personal Used Nike SasQuatch 'TW-1' 7.5° 460cc nexTI Tour Driver
driver.desc: For sale is Tiger Woods' actual Nike SasQuatch (SQ) Tour driver with the 'TW-1' personalization engraving that Tiger owned and used for practice sessions and or tournaments between 2006 and 2008. The 7.5 degree lofted yellow and grey 460cc head is on a Mitsubishi Diamana Blue 83 shaft here, each to the equipment model specifications of the 15-time major champion who was playing all Nike at this time. This driver is from a former PGA Tour winner and associate of Tiger Woods. That individual, who the previous owner met through the sports industry, obtained it directly from Woods in the late 2000’s after Tiger himself used it in the aforementioned practice sessions and or tournament capacity. It was not only carefully crafted and player issued by Nike to their top athlete Tiger Woods’ specifications, but they also included the highly significant ‘TW-1’ personalization engraved in the black hosel. Many in the industry are familiar with the 'What's in the Bag' Golfwrx blog that publishes the club options of tournament champions just after victory. These exact specs were used including the 7.5 degree head loft at the 2007 Tour Championship and historic 2008 US Open, among other tournaments, with its grip the only thing not original to the club. Further inspection will reveal there are ball marks on the face's sweet spot. A letter of provenance signed by the previous owner who's in the sports industry will be included. Please see all the photos and contact me with any questions. Signature delivery will be required. Thank you!

bag_buick.title: Tiger Woods Tournament-Used, Signed Buick Golf Bag Tiger Woods Personal Nike Bag
bag_buick.desc: For sale is a rare golf bag personally owned and used by Tiger Woods. Unfortunately, no COA. I emailed a consultant/authenticator who works for JSA and previously worked with PSA and he said he is 100% comfortable with the Tiger Woods signature being authentic. Therefore, I guarantee the autograph will pass any 3rd party authenticator or I will issue a full refund. This bag originally came from a Tiger Woods fundraiser auction. The original owner lost the COA that came with it and I have owned it ever since. If I had to guess, I would say this bag is circa 2006 or 2007. I found numerous photos of Tiger and caddie Stevie Williams with a bag that looks like this. Unfortunately, I have not found a specific photo match, but it could be a fun project for someone. As you can see, the bag shows wear. The wear is on the same side of the bag that rubs against Stevie Williams when he would have carried it on his side. Please see all the photos and contact me with any questions. A signature delivery will be required. Thank you!
